{{Top|leg}}
The '''MMR-9''' recovery [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was designed by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Imik Suum]] for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The droid was modeled after construction droids and was capable of operating in environments too hazardous for organic beings. The [[Fireclaw Horde]] had planned on using modified MMR-9s to hijack the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Queen of Cularin]]'', but failed. Subsequently, the droids were not released to the public.

==Behind the scenes==
The MMR-9 droid was first mentioned in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign adventure ''[[Jigsaw: In the Name of the Maker|In the Name of the Maker]]'', in which the model was referred to as the "MMR-8 recovery droid". They later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' which referred to them as "MMR-9"s, and this article assumes that the name given for them in the ''Encyclopedia'' is the correct one, because ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' was published after ''In the Name of the Maker''.
